name: Ray of Bedevilment
body:
School enchantment [mind-affecting]; Level bard 2, mesmerist 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect one ray of chaotic light
Duration 1d3 rounds
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You shoot a ray of chaotic light and energy at a target that clouds the mind of the target with peals of insane laughter. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack against the target to affect them. If affected, the target then must make a Will save or be dazed for 1d3 rounds.

On a successful save, the target is dazzled for 1 round.
